record_title: A rank-three threshold for abelianization of free-algebra locally nilpotent derivations
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Rank-two zero-detection and triangulability are prior work; the novelty claim is restricted to the higher-rank elementary-LND fiber theorem, the sharp rank-three threshold, and the graded size formula for the invisible kernel. The full texts of the 2020 Crode--Shestakov article and the 2007 Drensky--Yu survey were not inspected, so an equivalent elementary observation under different terminology remains a residual risk. arXiv:2609.19470v1 is recent and may be revised.
